name: c1rcle-platform
description: C1RCLE umbrella workspace: C1RCLE-FRONTEND (web apps) + C1RCLE-BACKEND (Fastify API gateway). Each is its own pnpm workspace; this root only delegates.

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir C1RCLE-BACKEND install && pnpm --dir C1RCLE-FRONTEND install
scripts.build: pnpm --dir C1RCLE-BACKEND build && pnpm --dir C1RCLE-FRONTEND build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir C1RCLE-BACKEND lint && pnpm --dir C1RCLE-FRONTEND lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir C1RCLE-BACKEND typecheck && pnpm --dir C1RCLE-FRONTEND typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir C1RCLE-BACKEND test && pnpm --dir C1RCLE-FRONTEND test
scripts.check: pnpm --dir C1RCLE-BACKEND check && pnpm --dir C1RCLE-FRONTEND check
scripts.format: pnpm --dir C1RCLE-BACKEND format && pnpm --dir C1RCLE-FRONTEND format
